definitions.gloss: practical skill; practical technique; hands-on test
definitions.explanation: Skills or techniques demonstrated through actual practice rather than theory. Also refers to a practical examination as opposed to a written one.

examples.japanese: {実技|じつぎ}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{筆記|ひっき}→筆記：00101_hikki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{実技|じつぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧し⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: You must pass both the written and practical exams.

examples.japanese: ⟦{教員|きょういん}→教員：12942_kyouin⟧⟦{免許|めんきょ}→免許：03808_menkyo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{実技|じつぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{履修|りしゅう}→履修：04861_rishuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: To get a teaching license, you need to take practical skill courses.

notes:
USAGE:
{実技|じつぎ} contrasts with ⟦{筆記|ひっき}→筆記：00101_hikki⟧ (written) or ⟦{学科|がっか}→学科：00053_gakka⟧ (academic subjects). It is commonly used in educational and certification contexts.

FORMS:
⟦{実|じつ}→実：28344_jitsu⟧ (actual, real) + {技|ぎ} (skill, technique).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実技|じつぎ}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧: practical exam
- {実技|じつぎ}⟦{科目|かもく}→科目：00163_kamoku⟧: practical subject
- {実技|じつぎ}⟦{指導|しどう}→指導：03190_shidou⟧: practical instruction
- {実技|じつぎ}⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧: practical test
